title: Follow-up: ADR 0003's identity bullet has one over-long line
description: Non-blocking nit from the DEC-183 round-5 APPROVE of opum-ai/glyph-cli#68 (GCLI-19), recorded verbatim on GCLI-19. ADR 0003:147 runs to about 115 columns - 'cache, and a warm entry keeps the answer it was built with. What the commit does carry — its tree and its own' - introduced by the round-5 re-flow of the Consequences identity entry. Cosmetic only: Markdown renders it the same. The lead ruled it must not be fixed in #68, so it rides a later change; fold it into whichever edit next touches that bullet.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ADR 0003's identity bullet is wrapped to the file's line width with no change in meaning.
